body.x: AirDog(www.airdog.com), a company made up of aviation engineers, embedded systems engineers, software engineers, combined with business and marketing professionals, unveiled "AirDog" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.AirDog is equipped with "AirLeash Technology," which acts just like a dog leash in the air, enabling automatic driving on air. It also has intelligent operating system, making it easy to operate. The special gyroscope stabilized gimbal takes stable and smooth photos and videos. Its flawless camera pitch control always puts subjects in the center of the shot automatically, which ensures that the shot of the action is always taken.It also folds up small enough to take it anywhere and is easy to store. It is fully compatible with GoPro Action camera attachment, which also comes with a waterproof case to accompany any action of AirDog.
